description: Browse this workspace's Library — every image/video generated in the Studio, and uploads (source:'upload'), newest first (the same Library the web app shows). Returns served URLs you can open directly or hand to fetch_asset for a download link, plus each asset's id (L0, L1…, which plan_ad and render_ad `inserts` take), a human TITLE (the ad's headline or concept, the prompt's first words, or the upload's name), kind, model, and age. When the user names an ad by its headline ("the Afternoon fix ad"), pass `query` to find it by title. Free, read-only.

query.description: only assets whose title contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. an ad headline the user quoted

name: list_library
title: List library
